def material_to_texture(material):
    """
    Convert a trimesh.visual.texture.Material object into
    a pyglet- compatible texture object.

    Parameters
    --------------
    material : trimesh.visual.texture.Material
      Material to be converted

    Returns
    ---------------
    texture : pyglet.image.Texture
      Texture loaded into pyglet form
    """
    # if we have a texture, load it
    if material.texture is not None:
        # if we have a path, load it
        if material.texture.path is not None:
            texture = pyglet.image.load(material.texture.path)
        # otherwise load it from data
        else:
            texture = pyglet.image.ImageData(
                material.texture.width,
                material.texture.height,
                material.texture.format,
                material.texture.data,
                pitch=material.texture.width *
